plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 5-date timeline completes: 340 AD (Ge Hong writes cold-water Qinghao malaria recipe in China) · 1820 (Pelletier and Caventou in Paris isolate quinine from Andean cinchona bark) · Easter 1856 (18-year-old William Henry Perkin in London accidentally synthesizes purple Mauveine dye while trying to make quinine) · 6 Nov 1880 & 20 Aug 1897 (Charles Laveran in Algeria and Ronald Ross in Secunderabad prove Plasmodium parasites inside female Anopheles mosquitoes cause malaria) · 4 Oct 1971 (Tu Youyou in Beijing uses 35 °C diethyl ether to create Sample #191 artemisinin with 100% malaria clearance) alongside the endoperoxide heme-activation diagram.
